title: Oracle Midday Brief
script_summary: Hashrate at 941.7 EH/s underscores sustained network strength even as Bitcoin trades flat at 63,009 with fear and greed at 34. Self-custody conversations are rising sharply, reflecting demand for absolute control without third-party gatekeepers. Marty Bent has noted the Fed remains boxed in on rates, a limit already built into Bitcoin's design. Andreas Antonopoulos has flagged this halving cycle as distinct, with the supply shock hitting a network hardened by prior rounds. Mempool sits at 77,663
